verdict.rationale: Stripe's invoicing tax docs state directly that Stripe Tax, Stripe's own first-party tax product, calculates sales tax, VAT, and GST on invoices, which delivers the core of the story through a first-class integration. Beyond that one documented line, the evidence pack is thin. Missing for 10: evidence on managing tax registrations, rate accuracy by jurisdiction, automatic application on every invoice, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
